description_en: Creates a NAT IP address for a VPC NAT gateway instance
description_zh: 为VPC NAT网关实例创建NAT IP地址
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-nat-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-gw8v16wgvtq26vh590000 --nat-ip-cidr 192.168.0.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNatIp

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC NAT gateway instance to which the NAT IP address belongs.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要创建NAT IP地址所属NAT网关实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the NAT IP address belongs
parameters.help_zh: NAT IP地址所属的VPC NAT网关实例ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the NAT IP address to create.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
创建的NAT IP地址的名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: nat_ip_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the NAT IP address to create.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
创建的NAT IP地址的描述信息。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: nat_ip_description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a dry run request. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the NAT IP address is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建NAT IP地址。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并创建NAT IP地址
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The NAT CIDR block from which the NAT IP address is created
parameters.help_zh: 创建NAT IP地址的地址段
parameters.name: nat_ip_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The NAT IP address to create.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly assigns an IP address from the NAT CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
创建的NAT IP地址。

如果您不指定该IP地址，系统会在您的NAT IP地址段中随机分配一个IP地址
parameters.name: nat_ip

parameters.help_en:
The IP prefix CIDR block to create.

The IP prefix CIDR block must be within the reserved CIDR block of the vSwitch where the NAT gateway resides, and the reserved CIDR block must not be occupied. The IP prefix mask must be /28
parameters.help_zh:
创建的IP前缀地址段。

该IP前缀地址段必须位于NAT所在交换机的预留网段内，且预留网段不能被占用。IP前缀掩码必须为/28
parameters.name: ipv4_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The number of IP prefixes to automatically assign.

The IP prefixes are randomly assigned from unallocated reserved CIDR blocks of the vSwitch where the NAT gateway resides. Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
自动分配的IP前缀数量。

从NAT所在交换机的未分配预留网段内随机分配。取值范围：1~10
parameters.name: ipv4_prefix_count
